paper: Cho 2015 Nat Commun (the only reference of the DOT1L -> MYC edge)
verbatim_quote: Although DOT1L did not change the total level of c-Myc expression (Fig. 4e), c-Myc was recruited to the DOT1L-occupied region of EMT-TF promoters
what_it_is_evidence_for: the edge's own reference reports no change in MYC level: the relation is co-binding at EMT-TF promoters in breast epithelial cells, not DOT1L raising MYC

verbatim_quote: The knockdown of c-Myc using siRNA blocked the increased EMT-TF expression caused by DOT1L overexpression in MCF10A cells
what_it_is_evidence_for: MYC acts downstream of / with DOT1L on EMT-TFs (direction MYC needed for DOT1L effect), in MCF10A

verbatim_quote: inhibition of DOT1L enzymatic activity with EPZ004777 treatment reversed DOT1L-induced EMT-TF expression in MCF10A cells
what_it_is_evidence_for: EPZ004777 was the tool in the edge reference, with an EMT-TF (not MYC) readout

verbatim_quote: both c-Myc RNA levels and protein levels were reduced after DOT1L silencing or inhibition
what_it_is_evidence_for: a second, non-reference context in which DOT1L inhibition (EPZ004777) lowers MYC RNA and protein: the edge sign is context-dependent

verbatim_quote: The results showed that 30 μM and 50 μM EPZ004777 significantly reduced cell viability of SW480 cells in a dose-dependent manner
what_it_is_evidence_for: cell-level concentrations of tens of micromolar against a biochemical IC50 of 0.4 nM

verbatim_quote: However, HCT116 was less sensitive to EPZ004777 treatment.
what_it_is_evidence_for: sensitivity differs between lines

verbatim_quote: Loss of DOT1L reduced the total number of PAX6- and SATB2-positive cells at E18.
what_it_is_evidence_for: genetic Dot1l loss in telencephalon reduces progenitors (PAX6) and upper-layer neurons (SATB2); SATB2 is already lower in the WWOX-KO organoid

verbatim_quote: Loss of DOT1L results in reduced numbers of progenitors expressing genes including SoxB1 gene family members.
what_it_is_evidence_for: DOT1L is required to keep progenitor numbers in mouse cortex

verbatim_quote: Transient inhibition of EZH2, EHMT1 and EHMT2 or DOT1L, at progenitor stage primes newly born neurons to rapidly acquire mature properties upon differentiation.
what_it_is_evidence_for: human-NPC datum pointing the other way: transient DOT1L inhibition accelerates neuronal maturation

verbatim_quote: Transient inhibition of EZH2, EHMT1/2 and DOT1L in NPCs using GSK343, UNC0638 and EPZ004777, respectively, induced increased NEFH and STX1A expression in d35 neurons
what_it_is_evidence_for: EPZ004777 itself was used in human NPCs (dose and schedule not found in the text served)

paper: Jiang 2020 Cancer Cell (the only reference of the AURKB -> MYC edge)
verbatim_quote: indicating a specific regulation of (c-)MYC, but not N-MYC, by Aurora B kinase.
what_it_is_evidence_for: AURKB-dependent stabilisation is c-MYC specific, N-MYC unchanged in neuroblastoma cells; neural progenitors rely heavily on MYCN

verbatim_quote: Pharmacologic targeting of AURKB by AZD1152, which specifically suppresses AURKB autophosphorylation (Figure S1C), diminished MYC expression as well in multiple T-ALL cells
what_it_is_evidence_for: the inhibitor used was AZD1152 (barasertib), not TAK-901; T-ALL cells

verbatim_quote: In contrast, Jurkat and PEER cells were resistant to AZD1152 associated with unchanged MYC abundance
what_it_is_evidence_for: even inside leukaemia the MYC response is not universal

verbatim_quote: These data suggest that decrease in MYC expression is required for T-ALL cells to respond to AZD1152 and expression of functional FBXW7 predicts anti-T-ALL efficacy.
what_it_is_evidence_for: the edge needs functional FBXW7-dependent degradation; FBXW7 status of WWOX-deficient radial glia is unknown

paper: Melatonin / AhR-Nrf2 in microglia, Int J Biol Sci 2025
verbatim_quote: Lentivirus transfection of AhR or FICZ significantly increased Nrf2 DNA-binding activity in LPS-treated cells
what_it_is_evidence_for: AhR agonist (FICZ) raises Nrf2 DNA-binding in LPS-treated microglia (BV2 / primary): direction AhR -> NRF2 up in a neural cell type

verbatim_quote: In an EMSA, LPS decreased AhR-regulated Nrf2 binding, which was blocked by melatonin or FICZ at 4 hours.
what_it_is_evidence_for: same, under inflammatory stimulus; not a basal or WWOX system

verbatim_quote: AhR-deficient mice displayed reduced cell birth, decreased cell survival, and diminished neuronal differentiation in the DG.
what_it_is_evidence_for: AhR is needed for normal adult neurogenesis (both loss and activation are adverse in this paper)

verbatim_quote: Following TCDD exposure, wild-type mice exhibited impaired hippocampal-dependent contextual memory, decreased cell birth, reduced neuronal differentiation, and fewer mature neurons in the DG.
what_it_is_evidence_for: adverse effects of AhR activation by a persistent agonist (TCDD); not transferable to a rapidly metabolised ligand without a measurement

paper: Neural precursor cells and TCDD, Stem Cells Dev 2011
verbatim_quote: TCDD suppresses NPC proliferation in a concentration-dependent manner without the loss of cell viability
what_it_is_evidence_for: AhR activation by TCDD slows NPC proliferation (G1 arrest) in vitro: abstract level

paper: AHR modulation in zebrafish brain, Front Mol Neurosci 2022
verbatim_quote: Early embryonic TCDD exposure impaired embryonic brain morphogenesis, resulted in ventriculomegaly, and disrupted neural connectivity
what_it_is_evidence_for: developmental neural hazard of AhR agonism (TCDD), abstract level

verbatim_quote: TAK-901 exhibited time-dependent, tight-binding inhibition of Aurora B, but not Aurora A.
what_it_is_evidence_for: primary description of TAK-901 selectivity between Aurora kinases (differs from the ChEMBL AURKA/TPX2 IC50 of 21 nM)

verbatim_quote: TAK-901 suppressed cellular histone H3 phosphorylation and induced polyploidy.
what_it_is_evidence_for: documented cellular engagement and the expected mitotic-failure phenotype

verbatim_quote: In various human cancer cell lines, TAK-901 inhibited cell proliferation with effective concentration values from 40 to 500 nmol/L.
what_it_is_evidence_for: cellular potency range (cancer lines)

verbatim_quote: TAK-901 potently inhibited only a few kinases other than Aurora B in intact cells, including FLT3 and FGFR2.
what_it_is_evidence_for: off-targets in intact cells named by the authors

verbatim_quote: tapinarof binds and activates AhR in multiple cell types, including cells of the target tissue-human skin
what_it_is_evidence_for: AhR agonism of the compound (primary)

verbatim_quote: tapinarof has no impact on imiquimod-induced skin inflammation in AhR-deficient mice
what_it_is_evidence_for: the anti-inflammatory effect in skin depends on AhR

paper: Miao 2005 J Biol Chem (the AHR -> NFE2L2 edge)
verbatim_quote: Cells with silenced AHR expression using siRNA also lost NRF2 mRNA induction by 2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin.
what_it_is_evidence_for: AHR-dependence of NRF2 transcript induction (TCDD, XRE-like elements in the mouse Nrf2 promoter); cell type not named in the abstract

paper: Tapinarof maximal use trial, Am J Clin Dermatol 2022
verbatim_quote: Tapinarof plasma exposure was low, with the majority of concentrations being below detectable limits.
what_it_is_evidence_for: systemic exposure after topical use in adults

paper: Tapinarof paediatric maximal usage trial, Am J Clin Dermatol 2025
verbatim_quote: Mean maximum plasma concentration (Cmax) was 2.44 ng/mL
what_it_is_evidence_for: highest systemic exposure figure found (children 2 years and older, extensive atopic dermatitis); total plasma, not brain

paper: Benvitimod healthy-subject study, Br J Dermatol 2014 (as indexed)
verbatim_quote: Following topical application, systemic absorption was negligible.
what_it_is_evidence_for: systemic absorption in healthy subjects

paper: Tapinarof clinical review, J Allergy Clin Immunol 2024
verbatim_quote: avoiding systemic safety concerns, drug interactions, or off-target effects
what_it_is_evidence_for: a review's claim about local exposure (a claim, not a measurement; the same abstract says AhR may be a target in nervous system diseases)

paper: Tapinarof AhR/Nrf2 in HaCaT, Toxicol Appl Pharmacol 2025
verbatim_quote: Tapinarof potentiated PM-induced CYP1A1 and HO-1 expression, confirming AhR/Nrf2 activation.
what_it_is_evidence_for: tapinarof activates the NRF2 arm in human keratinocytes (skin, not neural)

verbatim_quote: This dual pathway activation protected cells from PM-induced oxidative stress and cell death, as validated using the AhR antagonist, CH223191, and Nrf2 inhibitor, brusatol.
what_it_is_evidence_for: protection needed both arms in that model; whether NRF2 activation is downstream of AhR was not separated in the abstract

paper: Tapinarof redox chemistry and phototoxicity, Free Radic Biol Med 2024
verbatim_quote: tapinarof, being a moderate electron donor, is able to scavenge the ABTS radical and inhibit lipid peroxidation.
what_it_is_evidence_for: the molecule has intrinsic redox chemistry: an AhR-independent route to NRF2 tone cannot be excluded

verbatim_quote: In aqueous media at pH 7.4, we observed an ∼50 % degradation of tapinarof after 48 h at laboratory temperature.
what_it_is_evidence_for: chemical instability in aqueous medium: an in vitro dosing problem for multi-day neural cultures

verbatim_quote: The pharmacological inhibition and shRNA-mediated knockdown of DOT1L impaired proliferation and survival of NSCs.
what_it_is_evidence_for: DOT1L is needed for proliferation and survival of cortical neural stem cells in vitro

paper: DOT1L loss and neurodevelopmental disorder, Brain 2026
verbatim_quote: In primary cortical neurons, Dot1l knockdown disrupts transcription of synaptic genes, neuron branching, expression of a synaptic protein and neuronal activity.
what_it_is_evidence_for: human monoallelic DOT1L loss-of-function variants are linked to a neurodevelopmental disorder; neuronal, not progenitor, readouts

verbatim_quote: Exposure of leukemic cells to EPZ004777 results in selective killing of those cells bearing the MLL gene translocation, with little effect on non-MLL-translocated cells.
what_it_is_evidence_for: the compound's primary description: MLL-r-selective cytotoxicity

paper: VTAMA (tapinarof) cream US label, DailyMed set id 9309d20f-8cd4-4c96-93fa-7f730e83c7ab, SPL version 4, 2025-07-30
verbatim_quote: Plasma concentration of tapinarof was below the quantifiable limits (BQL) of the assay (lower limit of quantification was 50 pg/mL) in 68% of the PK samples.
what_it_is_evidence_for: adult plaque psoriasis maximal use

verbatim_quote: Human plasma protein binding of tapinarof is approximately 99% in vitro.
what_it_is_evidence_for: high protein binding: free systemic fraction is small

verbatim_quote: Tapinarof is an aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) agonist. The specific mechanisms by which VTAMA cream exerts its therapeutic actions are unknown.
what_it_is_evidence_for: label states AhR agonism and that the mechanism of therapeutic action is unknown

verbatim_quote: No tapinarof-related effects on postnatal development, neurobehavioral or reproductive performance of offspring were noted at doses up to 30 mg/kg/day
what_it_is_evidence_for: rat reproductive study, subcutaneous dosing; offspring neurobehaviour: the only developmental neural-adjacent safety datum found, not a brain-exposure measurement
